basic_info.description: Welcome to 2030 Alemany Blvd, a thoughtfully remodeled single-family home in the heart of Mission Terrace. An inviting entry with skylight overhead drenches the home with sunlight while beautiful wood floors flow throughout, bringing a warmth to this idyllic floorplan. Relax in the living room complete w/gas fireplace or steps away, a separate dining area opens up to a stylishly updated kitchen. Fitted with all the essentials, including SS-appliances & pot filler, plus quartz counters, modern cabinetry & subway tile backsplash, would inspire any home chef! The upper level offers an essential layout - boasting 3 bedrooms + office, and 2 bathrooms, including a primary bedroom w/sun bench & walk-in closet. 2 additional bedrooms, separated by a modern jack-and-jill bath, feature a chevron tiled rainfall shower & skylight. A second bath, home office, plus conveniently located upstairs washer/dryer, completes this level. Downstairs, two spacious bonus rooms, a storage room & 2-car garage provides ample space for options and the ultimate flex space!  With its own separate entry the possibilities are endless. Situated just steps away from shops, transit options, 280/101 access and Balboa Park's sports & recreation, makes owning your own part of SF a dream come true!
